info.title: MyLedja API
info.description: Generated from the Zod contracts by `npm run openapi`. Do not edit. Amounts are strings of whole minor units (kobo). Errors use the Error schema.

onBudget.description: "Count in budget". Off shows the "Tracking" tag.

balance.description: As shown: what you have, or for a card or loan what you owe.

clearedBalance.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

unclearedBalance.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

lastReconciledAt.description: Date of the last finished reconcile.

amount.description: The change to the balance as shown: positive raises what you have or what you owe.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

BalanceAdjustmentInput.description: E9 and E10. Never income or spending.

carried.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

activity.description: Spent: expense lines minus refunds dated in the month.

usedBasisPoints.description: Spent ÷ (planned + carried), in hundredths of a percent.

categories.description: Spending categories that are not hidden.

budgetable.description: Income in categories with "Count in budget" on.

planned.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

spent.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

anyOf.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

leftToPlan.description: Envelope only. Negative reads "Planned ₦X more than you have".

overspentFromLastMonth.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

leftToSpend.description: Sum of available (or remaining) above zero across categories.

carryOver.description: Spending limits style: carry what is left into next month.

system.description: Set for Interest and charges, Fees, Taxes and the like. They cannot be deleted.

doc.description: The record in the same shape its GET route returns; null for tombstones.

amount.description: One signed amount column, or use moneyIn and moneyOut.

lastMonth.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

spendingByDay.description: Cumulative spending by day of month.

change.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

accountId.description: A bank, cash or wallet account (E2), or a card (E3, E5).

amount.description: The total. With splits, the parts must add up to it exactly.

categoryId.description: One category. Leave out when sending splits.

splits.description: E12: two or more parts, each with its category.

amount.description: Whole minor units (kobo) above zero, as a string: "1845000" is ₦18,450.00.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

ExpenseInput.description: E2, E3, E5 and E12: spending, counted in the month it happens.

linkToken.description: Send as `googleLinkToken` with a password sign-in to link Google.

stored.description: Whether the file was kept in private Cloudinary storage.

anyOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.
Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

amount.description: Money in is positive.

duplicateOf.description: A likely duplicate: struck through and unticked.

error.description: Why the row could not be read. It will not be posted.

amount.description: Whole minor units (kobo) above zero, as a string: "1845000" is ₦18,450.00.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

IncomeInput.description: E1: money in, counted as income in its category.

id.description: Stable slug, for example "gtbank". Accounts store it as `institution`.

name.description: As people know it, for example "GTBank".

logoUrl.description: A public Cloudinary image (square, transparent background). Null until a logo is uploaded: show the initials.

aliases.description: Other names it goes by, for search ("Guaranty Trust Bank").

version.description: Changes whenever the list or a logo changes, so the app can cache the list.

amount.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

assets.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

owed.description: What you owe on cards and loans, as a positive figure.

partial.description: Currencies left out for want of a rate ("Partial").

amount.description: What you have, or for a card or loan what you owe, as a positive figure.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

OpeningBalanceInput.description: E8: where an account started. Never income.

targetId.description: The record a correct, reverse or update acts on; for budget.assign, the category. Month goes in the payload.

payload.description: The body of the matching route: transaction.create takes createTransaction's body, and so on.

schemaVersion.description: The current and the previous version are accepted.

result.description: applied and duplicate: what the matching route returns.

aliases.description: "Also appears as": raw bank names that map here.

clientId.description: Google's public OAuth client id, when set up.

PublicConfig.description: Which optional services are on, so the app hides what is off (TECH-SPEC 2.3 rule 3). No secrets.

candidates.description: Uncleared and recently cleared, up to the statement date.

statementBalance.description: What the bank said, kept apart from the calculated one.

accountId.description: Where the money came back to.

amount.description: Whole minor units (kobo) above zero, as a string: "1845000" is ₦18,450.00.

categoryId.description: Which of a split purchase's categories it comes back to. Defaults to the purchase's first one.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

RefundInput.description: E11: a seller giving money back. Lowers the purchase category's spending in the refund's month.

refreshToken.description: Null when the refresh token was set as a cookie.
Null when the refresh token was set as a cookie.

amount.description: The headline amount: money out is negative, money in positive, a transfer its size.

accountIds.description: Your accounts it touches; a transfer lists from, then to.

edited.description: True when this replaced an earlier version ("Edited").

anyOf.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

runningBalance.description: Only when the list is filtered to one account.

history.description: Earlier versions and their reversals, oldest first.

refundable.description: What can still be refunded (purchases only).

accountId.description: Set when the line is on one of your accounts.

categoryId.description: Set when the line is on a category.

amount.description: Positive is a debit, negative a credit (TECH-SPEC 6.1).
What left the first account, in its currency.

toAmount.description: E7 only: what arrived, in the second account's currency. Required when the currencies differ.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in the workspace time zone.

TransferInput.description: E4, E6 and E7: money between your own accounts, including paying a card. Never income or spending.

amount.description: Whole minor units (kobo) as a string, for example "1845000" for ₦18,450.00.

setupComplete.description: False until Welcome is finished; the app opens Welcome.

post.summary: Continue with Google
post.description: A new email creates an account. An email that already has a password answers 409 google_link_needed; sign in once with the password and `googleLinkToken` to link. 404 google_off when Google sign-in is not set up.

parameters.name: X-Operation-Id
parameters.description: A UUID made on the device. Retries reuse it, and the server runs the change once.

staySignedIn.description: Web only. When true the refresh token is set as an HttpOnly cookie and `refreshToken` comes back null. Phones send false and keep the token in Keychain or Keystore.

400.description: The input was refused; `field` names the field and `message` can be shown beside it

401.description: Not signed in, or the details are wrong

404.description: Not found, or not in a workspace you belong to
